brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy - organized storage with compartments
requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster with bin:0,0,0 div2 compartments and bin:0,1,0 full bin provides sorting; tape, tweezers, pencil props staged in compartments show sewing notions organization
Two rod accessories (accessory:0#1,0#0 and 0#0,0#3) provide hanging points for thread/cord; full axle spool not formed due to geometry but rods serve as hooks

finish.summary: Compact 3-cell hexagonal organizer: one div2 bin for small notions (needles, buttons) and one full bin for larger items, with two rod accessories for thread. Dressed with tape, tweezers, pencil to demonstrate sewing kit use. Capped and bolted.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
